reasons: The characterization freeze did not pre-register every minimum failure class required by W1-QUAL-01R section 20.
The Knowledge input gate recorded eligible=true rather than the mandatory explicit KNOWLEDGE_INPUT_USABLE_FOR_ST_CHARACTERIZATION=YES/NO field.

The trace index retained run and event references but did not persist the required per-run KnowledgeResult digest, candidate counts, gaps, limitations, duration and diagnostics as directly inspectable trace evidence.
The C3 mechanistic case produced zero mechanism candidates, but the frozen envelope contained no mechanism-specific obligation; the required mechanistic coverage therefore was not adjudicated.

The C7 Acceptance Envelope required zero hypotheses and zero objectives, although admitted authorities permit explicitly pending candidates while preserving Project unknowns; the exact zero-candidate expectation is not normatively compelled.

observedDivergence.observedBehavior: The ST request adapter used caller purpose as validatedReformulation because the Project contained no SCIENTIFIC_QUESTION; ST produced pending generic candidates while retaining PROJECT_SCIENTIFIC_QUESTION_NOT_EXPLICIT and all Project unknowns.
